page: Microsoft Azure L16s_v3 is a storage-optimized virtual machine hosted on Microsoft Hyper-V. Driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8370C processor operating at 2.8 GHz, this configuration provides 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core. The hardware subsystem includes 48 MB of L3 cache along with instruction set support for AVX-512, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory and incorporates a bundled 4,012 GB local NVMe SSD array. It does not include dedicated graphics processing units.

Benchmark assessments show steady mid-range computational capability, reflecting a PassMark CPU rating of 21,313.63, a Geekbench multi-core score of 10,151.0, and a multi-threaded stress-ng result of 15,536.57. The memory subsystem exhibits upper-quartile behavior, attaining a PassMark memory score of 2,765.45 and achieving 100.34 GB/s in uncached large-block sequential read throughput. In data serving evaluations, the system sustains 15.98 million Redis SET operations per second alongside 21.98 GB/s in static web throughput. Without GPU hardware, CPU-driven language model processing yields 783.53 tokens per second on prompt evaluations for 135M parameter models and 35.13 tokens per second for 7B models.

The integrated 4,012 GB NVMe SSD volume offers high local resource density without relying on network-attached storage disks, improving efficiency for read- and write-intensive data services. However, the moderate compute capacity and absence of hardware acceleration restrict its viability for heavy artificial intelligence model training or parallel mathematical modeling. The server configuration is suited for relational database management systems, distributed NoSQL datastores, Redis caching deployments, search indexes, and large-scale log processing pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure L16s_v3 is a storage-optimized virtual machine featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. The x86_64 configuration integrates 48 MB of L3 cache, AVX-512 extensions, and 128.0 GB of system memory, alongside a bundled 4,012 GB local NVMe SSD. Operating without hardware GPU acceleration, the system achieves balanced mid-tier compute scores, marked by a multi-core Geekbench score of 10,151.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 21,313.63, while demonstrating strong memory throughput with large-block uncached reads reaching 100.34 GB/s. The extensive local NVMe storage and robust memory bandwidth provide favorable density for I/O-heavy applications, offsetting its moderate pure compute throughput. It is specifically suited for high-throughput transactional databases, NoSQL storage, distributed caching systems, and data warehousing workloads requiring large low-latency local storage.
